name: Hildegard of Bingen completes Scivias
summary: After ten years of composition, the Benedictine abbess Hildegard of Bingen completes Scivias ('Know the Ways'), a trilogy of twenty-six theological visions accompanied by richly programmatic illuminations. The work circulates widely after Eugenius III's endorsement at the synod of Trier (1147).

_quarry.structural_significance: Foundational text of medieval women's mystical literature; Hildegard's papal-endorsed visionary authority opens space for later female theological writers (Mechthild, Marguerite Porete, Catherine of Siena).
